facts_paraphrased: Section 8.3 recommends 0.1 uF VDD-to-GND decoupling and conditionally adds comparator input capacitors for noisy monitored rails.
Divider bias-current error must be considered if divider current is less than 100 times comparator input current; output pull-up choice must respect the desired low output voltage.
Section 10.1 asks for the 0.1 uF capacitor close to VDD. Figure 23 shows a local bypass connection and input/output resistor arrangement; no numeric 4 mm layout threshold is specified.
project_screen_boundary: The existing 4 mm pad-distance gate is an ASSUMED project screen. A/B nominal distances of 2.706618/1.755393 mm do not establish actual bypass path impedance or a short supply-return loop.
application_status: Full input accuracy, noise, bypass loop, output loading, thermal and coupling review remains NOT_TESTED. No schematic/value/capacitor changes were made from this reading.
